# temps_access_vault_link (Resource)

Gives a project's sandboxes, or one sandbox, the services of a `temps_access_vault`.

Import with `<vault_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_access_vault_link" "web" {
  vault_id   = temps_access_vault.finance.id
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vault_id` (String) ID of the access vault.

### Optional

- `project_id` (Number) Project whose sandboxes get the vault.
- `sandbox_id` (String) One sandbox that gets the vault.

### Read-Only

- `consumer_name` (String) Name of the project or sandbox.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `<vault_id>/<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <vault_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_access_vault_link.web vault_0123456789abcdef/4
```
